//: Copy to config.json and fill in. All resources are created fresh in YOUR tenant.

fabric.//capacityId: REQUIRED. Existing Fabric capacity resource id or capacity GUID. A workspace cannot be created without a capacity (F-SKU or Trial).
fabric.//siteCount: OPTIONAL. Number of extra synthetic sites to fan out from the reference site after data load (0 = single reference site only). Each new site is healthy/stable; capped at the built-in site catalog (12).

//data: OPTIONAL. Where the lightweight wizard seeds the demo data from when no local data/ bundle is present. Pulled cloud-to-cloud into OneLake. Defaults to the public release asset below.
//telemetry: OPTIONAL. On deploy, the wizard reports a one-time install event (tenant, signed-in user, subscription, region, workspace name, wizard version, outcome) to Microsoft OGE's Application Insights so the team can see adoption. DEFAULT ON. Set enabled=false to opt out (or uncheck the box in the wizard, or set env ONEGRID_TELEMETRY=0). Set connectionString to send to your own App Insights instead.
//fixedIdentity: OPTIONAL. A service principal (with a client secret) used as the Import semantic model's data-source identity so it can refresh from the Lakehouse SQL endpoint. If provided, deploy binds a connection + refreshes automatically; otherwise do it manually (see README).

foundry.//models: Deployment name | catalog model | version | format | capacity

//governance: OPTIONAL. The OneLake security / data-governance plane. When enabled, the 'governance' phase provisions OneLake data-access roles on the lakehouse (table/row/column scoped) mapped to the persona Entra security groups below, and the app surfaces a read-only /governance review plane that inventories 'who can access what'. Fabric/OneLake remain the authoritative enforcement layer; the review plane is inventory + explanation only. Supply object IDs of EXISTING Entra security groups (never distribution lists). Leave a group blank to skip its role. No secrets belong in this block.

governance.//mode: demo = provision illustrative persona roles + sample RLS/CLS; inventory = only stand up the review plane over whatever roles already exist (no role writes).
governance.//groups: Object IDs of existing Entra security groups. These become the members of the OneLake data-access roles and the app's persona/reviewer authorization.
governance.//leastPrivilegeApp: When true, the permissions phase grants the container-app identity least privilege (Power BI workspace Viewer + semantic-model Build) instead of workspace Member, so the runtime identity cannot bypass model RLS or write to the workspace. Default false preserves the original Member grant.
governance.//autoCreateGroups: Demo mode only. When true (default), the governance phase auto-creates the persona Entra security groups (OneGrid-Executives, -ControlRoom, -Maintenance, -OntologyReaders) for any group left blank above and adds the deploying user, so the OneLake roles are demonstrable out of the box. Requires directory rights to create groups; if unavailable, the phase falls back to seeding the signed-in user directly as a role member. Set false to only use the explicit object ids above.
governance.//sqlEndpointUserIdentityMode: When true, the governance phase attempts to switch the Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint to user-identity mode so SQL queries enforce OneLake roles per-user (required to demonstrate row/column security through the SQL endpoint).
governance.//reviewRetentionDays: How long access snapshots are retained by the review plane.
